name: claude-os
description: Claude OS and its vetted external pack. Every third-party entry here has been cloned, licence-read and executable-audited, and carries a ruling in docs/architecture/skill-overlap.md. Nothing at evaluation or blocked status is listed.

plugins.name: claude-os
plugins.description: The operating system itself: 29 specialist agents, 36 skills, 8 commands. Start here — the rest of this marketplace is optional capability on top.

plugins.name: no-ai-slop
plugins.description: 20+ named AI writing patterns, with edit and detect modes. The prose half of the anti-slop gate — Claude OS's own anti-slop skill judges the render, this judges the copy. Vetted 2026-09-05: MIT, prompt-only, no hooks.

plugins.name: superseo
plugins.description: 11 SEO execution skills (briefs, drafting, semantic gap, clusters, snippets, E-E-A-T, link strategy). Sits ON TOP of Claude OS's technical-seo + geo, which remain the gate. Vetted 2026-09-05: Apache-2.0, prompt-only, zero executables, no API keys. Vendor-authored — treat methodology as opinion.

plugins.name: mattpocock-selected
plugins.description: A deliberate 9-skill subset of Matt Pocock's 25. Excluded on purpose: code-review, tdd, research, implement, prototype, triage, codebase-design (duplicated by Claude OS agents + Superpowers) and git-guardrails (a PreToolUse hook that would stack on pre-tool-guard.sh). Install the upstream mattpocock marketplace instead if you want all 25.

plugins.name: lets-scroll
plugins.description: Scroll-scrubbed cinematic landing pages. COSTS REAL MONEY — pay-per-clip video generation; the skill must state the estimate and get approval before any spend. Use r3f-scenes instead when you need real interactive 3D.
